headline: LT Foods Americas Acquires Maya Kaimal Foods
summary: LT Foods Americas acquired Maya Kaimal Foods, uniting its basmati rice brand with an Indian meal and sauce brand to expand its product offerings for American households.
why: LT Foods Americas is the U.S. unit of a prominent global basmati rice producer, expanding its footprint in the specialty food market through targeted acquisitions.
